text:
anne-infra: Heads-up — us-east1 spot evictions jumped 3x overnight, knocked out a couple of training pools. Thinking we should adjust our procurement mix. Anyone have a quick plan for capacity vs price-optimized weighting? :thinking_face:
sam-spot: saw the alerts. My instinct: move short-lived / throughput-y jobs to price-optimized, but critical long-running jobs to capacity-optimized. Also increase hedging for the p4/d-style pools (higher eviction sensitivity).
priyanka: +1. We should also make the mix dynamic by interruption probability. If eviction_rate(region, instance) > 0.02 then shift weight -> capacity-optimized by 60-80%.
anne-infra: nice — can we codify that into a strategy we can flip quickly? i.e., a config toggle per pool.
sam-spot: we have a draft policy in config form. simple example:
```
pools:
  - name: training-short
    strategy: price_optimized
    max_spot_loss: 0.05
  - name: training-long
    strategy: capacity_optimized
    reserve_pct: 0.15  # warm buffer of on-demand/reserved
dynamic_rules:
  - metric: eviction_rate
    threshold: 0.02
    action: promote_to_capacity
```
We can wire that into autoscaler to rebalance weights.
priyanka: also add a soft-eviction buffer: keep N idle reserved GPUs per region to absorb requeues. That cuts tail restart time a lot. For numbers: 10% warm buffer for long jobs, 3% for short.
anne-infra: what's the cost hit for warm buffer? we need an ROI calc before ops approves.
sam-spot: rough calc: warm buffer 10% ~= +10% capacity cost but reduces requeue/cold-start overhead which for long jobs saved cost ~= 20-30% in wasted GPU-hours during high churn. I'll run model-level sims.
priyanka: we should also bias bidding slightly above the market floor for pools we care about. Not huge — +5-7% price premium to reduce churn. It's cheaper than constant re-runs.
anne-infra: ok. we should add metrics to watch in console: eviction_rate, median_restart_time, wasted_gpu_hours, and effective_cost_per_successful_job.
sam-spot: agreed. I'll add per-pool dashboards and an alert when wasted_gpu_hours > 1% of weekly consumption.
deploy-bot: schedule: rolling config rollout to test workspace at 2026-06-02T03:00:00Z. Runbook step: if average latency > 15% or eviction_rate increases after rollout, rollback.
priyanka: can we also add region-fallback policy? i.e., if region eviction_rate > 0.05 AND capacity_utilization(region) > 0.85 then shift new allocations to secondary region until stable.
anne-infra: yes — include region transfer limits and cross-region egress cost estimate. Put a cooldown so we don't thrash regions.
sam-spot: I'll spin up a small sim job tomorrow to validate mix change and buffer sizes. tagging @priyanka for validation script.
priyanka: will do. plan: sim across last 90 days of market history and produce expected savings vs extra buffer cost.
anne-infra: sweet. if all good, let's aim to roll to prod next week. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
